atoms.b: The US has two major mountain ranges: The ((Rocky_Mountains Rockies)) in the West and the ((Appalachian_Mountains Appalachians)) in the East. Between them lie the ((Interior_Plains)), whose westernmost region is called the ((Great_Plains)).
The ocean West of the US is the ((Pacific_Ocean Pacific)), while the East Coast meets the ((Atlantic_Ocean Atlantic)). The country borders on ((Canada)) in the North and ((Mexico)) in the South.

atoms.sound: My grandfather used to live in a big, densely populated city when he was young. He moved there to work for a car manufacturing company, but he had trouble finding work for a long time. It was very hard on him. Eventually, he went back home to the countryside and worked as a farmer like his parents did.
